description: Create a freeze frame from a clip at a specific time. Exports the frame and imports it back as a still image.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the freeze frame on the timeline (default: 2)

output_path.description: Full path for the exported frame (e.g., /path/to/freeze.png)

time_seconds.description: Time in the sequence to freeze (in seconds). Uses playhead if omitted.

name: freeze_frame

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Freeze Frame
